name: Torrid Tales
source:
A small neighborhood gets paid a visit and unknowingly becomes part of a science project that corrupts their morals and leads them to a lifestyle of debauchery.


[From [url=https://www.patreon.com/JWBNovels]Patreon[/url]]
translation:
一个小社区迎来了一位访客，居民们却在不知不觉中成为一项科学实验的一部分。实验腐化了他们的道德观，并把他们引向放纵的生活方式。

（来源：[url=https://www.patreon.com/JWBNovels]Patreon[/url]）
